healthLog.title: Health log
healthLog.intro: How you feel (a symptom, where and how bad), numbers you measure at home (temperature, blood pressure, weight) and dated text from lab results, diagnoses, medications and doctor letters. It stays on this device and can be included in an Ask context pack.
healthLog.titlePlaceholderSymptom: e.g. Aching in both hands since morning
healthLog.detailsSymptom: Details (when it started, what makes it better or worse, what you took)
healthLog.detailsMeasurement: Details (time of day, before or after a meal, which arm, what device)
healthLog.detailsOther: Text (paste the relevant values or wording from the paper)
healthLog.bodyPlaceholderSymptom: Started after waking up, both hands stiff for about an hour, better after warm water.
healthLog.bodyPlaceholderMeasurement: Morning, seated, left arm, after five minutes of rest.
healthLog.transcribedNotice: Transcribed by a model from your document; check every number against the paper before saving.
